What products are out of stock at store:
SELECT
    prod_name,
    brand_name,
    cat_name,
    depa_name,
    risk_flag,
    on_order_qty,
    last_received_dt,
    days_since_last_sale
FROM retail.vw_store_inventory_health
WHERE str_id = '5'
  AND risk_flag LIKE 'OUT_OF_STOCK%'
ORDER BY days_since_last_sale DESC;
Store inventory health summary:
SELECT
    str_name,
    risk_flag,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count,
    SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand,
    SUM(shrinkage_qty) AS total_shrinkage
FROM retail.vw_store_inventory_health
WHERE snapshot_dt = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_dt) FROM retail.store_inventory)
GROUP BY str_name, risk_flag
ORDER BY str_name, risk_flag;
Which stores have the most out-of-stock:
SELECT
    str_name,
    str_type,
    reg_name,
    COUNT(*) AS oos_products
FROM retail.vw_store_inventory_health
WHERE risk_flag IN ('OUT_OF_STOCK', 'OUT_OF_STOCK_REORDER_PENDING')
  AND snapshot_dt = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_dt) FROM retail.store_inventory)
GROUP BY str_name, str_type, reg_name
ORDER BY oos_products DESC;
Show shrinkage by store and department:
SELECT
    str_name,
    depa_name,
    SUM(shrinkage_qty) AS total_shrinkage,
    SUM(shrinkage_qty * unit_cost_amt) AS shrinkage_cost
FROM retail.vw_store_inventory_health
WHERE shrinkage_qty > 0
GROUP BY str_name, depa_name
ORDER BY shrinkage_cost DESC;
Products below safety stock at store 12:
SELECT
    prod_name,
    brand_name,
    on_hand_qty,
    safety_stock_qty,
    reorder_point_qty,
    on_order_qty,
    lead_time_days,
    risk_flag
FROM retail.vw_store_inventory_health
WHERE str_id = '12'
  AND risk_flag IN ('BELOW_SAFETY_STOCK', 'BELOW_REORDER_POINT')
ORDER BY on_hand_qty ASC;
Perishable products at risk in the North:
SELECT
    str_name,
    prod_name,
    cat_name,
    on_hand_qty,
    shelf_life_days,
    lead_time_days,
    days_since_restock
FROM retail.vw_store_inventory_health
WHERE reg_name = 'Northeast'
  AND is_perishable = 1
  AND risk_flag = 'PERISHABLE_LEAD_TIME_RISK'
ORDER BY days_since_restock DESC;
Which products have inventory risk?:
SELECT
    prod_name,
    brand_name,
    cat_name,
    wh_name,
    reg_name,
    safety_stock_qty,
    reorder_point_qty,
    lead_time_days,
    risk_flag
FROM retail.vw_inventory_health
WHERE risk_flag <> 'OK'
ORDER BY risk_flag, prod_name;
Show perishable products where lead time:
SELECT
    prod_name,
    cat_name,
    wh_name,
    reg_name,
    lead_time_days,
    shelf_life_days,
    lead_time_days - shelf_life_days AS days_over
FROM retail.vw_inventory_health
WHERE is_perishable = 1
  AND lead_time_days > shelf_life_days
ORDER BY days_over DESC;
Inventory overview for the Northwest war:
SELECT
    prod_name,
    cat_name,
    safety_stock_qty,
    reorder_point_qty,
    lead_time_days,
    demand_channel,
    forecast_horizon_days,
    risk_flag
FROM retail.vw_inventory_health
WHERE wh_name LIKE '%Northwest%'
ORDER BY risk_flag DESC, prod_name;
Products with the longest lead times:
SELECT TOP 10
    prod_name,
    brand_name,
    cat_name,
    wh_name,
    reg_name,
    lead_time_days,
    safety_stock_qty,
    reorder_point_qty
FROM retail.vw_inventory_health
ORDER BY lead_time_days DESC;
Inventory risk summary by region:
SELECT
    reg_name,
    risk_flag,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM retail.vw_inventory_health
GROUP BY reg_name, risk_flag
ORDER BY reg_name, risk_flag;
Discontinued products still in inventory:
SELECT
    prod_name,
    brand_name,
    cat_name,
    wh_name,
    reg_name,
    safety_stock_qty
FROM retail.vw_inventory_health
WHERE risk_flag = 'DISCONTINUED'
ORDER BY reg_name, wh_name;
Which warehouses carry the most at-risk:
SELECT
    wh_name,
    reg_name,
    COUNT(*) AS risk_products,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_flag = 'PERISHABLE_LEAD_TIME_RISK' THEN 1 END) AS perishable_risk,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_flag = 'DISCONTINUED' THEN 1 END) AS discontinued
FROM retail.vw_inventory_health
WHERE risk_flag <> 'OK'
GROUP BY wh_name, reg_name
ORDER BY risk_products DESC;
How many products are out of stock?:
SELECT
    oos_category,
    oos_severity,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT prod_id) AS distinct_products
FROM retail.vw_oos_classification
WHERE oos_category <> 'OK'
GROUP BY oos_category, oos_severity
ORDER BY CASE oos_severity
    WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1
    WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 2
    WHEN 'MONITORING' THEN 3
END;
Show me all critical out-of-stock produc:
SELECT
    prod_name,
    brand_name,
    cat_name,
    wh_name,
    reg_name,
    oos_category,
    days_since_last_sale,
    avg_daily_units_14d,
    total_units_14d,
    last_sale_date
FROM retail.vw_oos_classification
WHERE oos_category IN ('CHRONIC_OOS', 'LIKELY_OOS')
ORDER BY days_since_last_sale DESC;
Which regions have the most out-of-stock:
SELECT
    reg_name,
    oos_category,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT prod_id) AS distinct_products
FROM retail.vw_oos_classification
WHERE oos_category IN ('CHRONIC_OOS', 'LIKELY_OOS', 'AT_RISK')
GROUP BY reg_name, oos_category
ORDER BY reg_name,
    CASE oos_category
        WHEN 'CHRONIC_OOS' THEN 1
        WHEN 'LIKELY_OOS' THEN 2
        WHEN 'AT_RISK' THEN 3
    END;
Products at risk of running out before r:
SELECT
    prod_name,
    brand_name,
    cat_name,
    wh_name,
    reg_name,
    safety_stock_qty,
    lead_time_days,
    avg_daily_units_14d,
    ROUND(est_days_of_coverage, 1) AS est_days_of_coverage,
    lead_time_days - ROUND(est_days_of_coverage, 0) AS coverage_gap_days
FROM retail.vw_oos_classification
WHERE oos_category = 'AT_RISK'
ORDER BY est_days_of_coverage ASC;
Which products are slowing down?:
SELECT
    prod_name,
    brand_name,
    cat_name,
    wh_name,
    reg_name,
    avg_daily_units_14d,
    avg_daily_units_7d,
    ROUND(velocity_change_pct * 100, 1) AS velocity_change_pct
FROM retail.vw_oos_classification
WHERE oos_category = 'SLOW_MOVING'
ORDER BY velocity_change_pct ASC;
OOS summary by department:
SELECT
    depa_name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN oos_category = 'CHRONIC_OOS' THEN 1 END) AS chronic_oos,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN oos_category = 'LIKELY_OOS' THEN 1 END) AS likely_oos,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN oos_category = 'AT_RISK' THEN 1 END) AS at_risk,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN oos_category = 'SLOW_MOVING' THEN 1 END) AS slow_moving,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN oos_category = 'OK' THEN 1 END) AS ok,
    COUNT(*) AS total
FROM retail.vw_oos_classification
WHERE is_discontinued = 0
GROUP BY depa_name;
Perishable products by department:
SELECT
    depa_name,
    cat_name,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count,
    AVG(CAST(lead_time_days AS FLOAT)) AS avg_lead_time,
    AVG(CAST(shelf_life_days AS FLOAT)) AS avg_shelf_life
FROM retail.vw_inventory_health
WHERE is_perishable = 1
GROUP BY depa_name, cat_name
ORDER BY avg_lead_time DESC;
